sentences.text: Km Nisha And Another vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023

Author: Shekhar Kumar Yadav
Bench: Shekhar Kumar Yadav
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:146158
Court No. - 71
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 8033 of 2023
Applicant :- Km Nisha And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Raghubir Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Manoj Mishra,Shubham Singh
Hon'ble Shekhar Kumar Yadav,J.
1.
Heard Sri Raghubir Singh, learned counsel for applicants, Sri Manoj Mishra, learned counsel for the informant and learned A.G.A. for State as well as perused the material available on record.

2. The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the applicant for protection in regard to Case Crime No.145 of 2022, under Sections 323, 420, 380, 411, 504, 506 I.P.C., P.S.- Sadar Bazar, District- Agra during the pendency of investigation.
3. After arguing for some time, applicant's counsel submits that he does not want to press the prayer for release of the applicant on anticipatory bail.

His sole prayer is that a direction may be issued to the court below to decide the bail application of the applicants in view of the judgement in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Km Nisha And Another vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110915807/
1

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Km Nisha And Another vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the informant have no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for the applicant.

5. In view of the above, considering the aforesaid alternative prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant, the present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with the direction that in case the applicant filed bail application before the court below within thirty days from today, the same shall be heard and disposed of expeditiously by the court below in view of the settled law laid down by this court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
6.
For the aforesaid period, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
7. With the above observations and directions, this application is disposed of.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Krishna*
